objective: Preallocate WAL replay entry buffers with a bounded file-size capacity hint.

tasks.title: Preallocate WAL replay entries
tasks.result: WAL segment replay now initializes its entry vector from a bounded file-size capacity hint.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was previously full.
The capacity hint is bounded at 8192 entries to avoid oversized allocation for large 64 MB WAL segments.
The change preserves replay parsing, partial-tail truncation, and segment ordering behavior.
